exposure: human amniotic epithelial stem cells-conditioned media (hAECs-CM)
cohort: Breast cancer cell lines (MCF-7, MDA-MB-231) and cervical cancer cell line (HeLa) in vitro were treated with conditioned medium derived from human amniotic epithelial stem cells.
finding: hAECs-CM demonstrated dose-time-dependent cytotoxicity against cancerous cell lines, significantly inhibiting cell proliferation and migration while inducing cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.
